subject: the Compressor Auto Gain and Distortion Controls rows through the verified read-only parameter path
question: On the protected fixture, does the exact candidate read each named popup's current value, restore the view and close its newly opened editor without opening either popup or calling a setter?

reverify.expected: exits 0 and writes a receipt whose checks are all true: both popup values return State A strings with write_attempted false, both view restores and new-editor closes are observed, before and after inventories identify the same target, and stdin close removes the server process
reverify.cost: about thirty seconds on the protected fixture with stopped playback

method: Built debug product LogicProMCP at candidate b77eff0df2681873b8181de68e83323ffbb83983 (tree 74b7d9d756c9c6d17b89521bb74c29f3b2096bd4; binary SHA-256 2b0f20352f1ee8d0054b2ebf674bda038c25d03992a68b4c84d885baa991b1d3). Each read sampled the already-selected AXValue without a menu action. The same inventory was read again, the server exited from stdin close, and independent UI readback again found only the protected project window. No setter, save, project close, key input or click input was used.

observations.what: independent native UI readback after the server stopped

conclusion: The exact candidate read Auto Gain as -12 dB and Distortion as Off in State A, opened neither popup, called no setter, observed each view restoration and new-editor close, and left the same complete target inventory before and after.
